entry.title: Where is Bilguun’s Shelter in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
Bilguun's Shelter is a new POI in ARC Raiders introduced as part of the Shrouded Sky update.
Not only does this place have loot, but it's part of a quest as well. While the loot isn't worth writing about, you have to figure the location out if you're interested in completing Keeping an Eye Out in ARC Raiders.
This guide will help you with the exact location of the Shelter and how to reach it.
Bilguun's Shelter location in ARC Raiders
The Bilguun's Shelter is located in the southern part of the Blue Gate map. You have to visit this spot to complete the Keeping an Eye Out quest in ARC Raiders. Your key objective is to visit the place to find any clues about Bilguun's presence. However, you can also visit this spot to get extra loot.
Screenshot and remix by Destructoid
The Shelter is different from Bilguun's Hideout, which is located on Spaceport. To reach the Shelter, you'll want to be at the spot marked on the image below. Once you reach the spot, you'll find the collapsed part of the highway. You'll need to reach the upper part of the highway. There are two ways to do that. You can either use a zipline or go around and climb up.
Image via Embark
Once you reach the edge, look down carefully (don't fall). Once you note a ledge, drop down. You'll grab the ledge when you're about to fall. Climb up, and you've reached Bilguun's Shelter. Head inside, and you'll find some lootable items (as long as other players haven't visited the spot before you).
That's all you need to know about finding the Shelter. The loot you get from here is pretty basic, so don't go on expecting to find Mythic blueprints. There's a nearby shaft as well that you can use to escape to Speranza.

entry.title: How to complete Keeping an Eye Out in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
The Keeping and Eye Out quest is now live in ARC Raiders as part of the Shrouded Sky update, and you can finish/complete it for some amazing rewards.
You can get the quest from Celeste. Spread across several steps, it isn't very hard to complete as long as you know what needs to be done. This guide will help you complete all the tasks quickly, so that you can explore the remaining parts of the new update.
ARC Raiders Keeping an Eye Out quest walkthrough
The Keeping an Eye Out quest can be broken down into the following parts.
Locate the Collapsed Highway by the southern edge of Barren Clearing.
Head to Bilguun's Shelter and search for any clues of his presence.
Head to the Blue Gate map, and then travel all the way south near the Collapsed Highway marker. I have marked the spot on the image below. Reach the location, and the first part of the task is done. You won't have to do anything extra, and the quest will automatically update once you reach the spot.
Screenshot and remix by Destructoid
Next, we have to reach Bilguun's Shelter and find clues of his presence. Bilguun's Shelter is a different location from his Hideout. Once you reach the location, you have to look for evidence of Bilguun.
Image via Embark
Finding the shelter is slightly tricky. Check the image above. We have to reach the top of the highway in front of us. Using a zipline is easiest, but you can also go around and travel a bit further. Once you're on top of the highway, jump down carefully to fall and catch the ledge. Climb up and voila! You've reached Bilguun's Shelter.
Image via Embark
Go inside, and you'll be able to snap a photo. This automatically completes the second task and finishes Keeping an Eye out. Once done, you can just escape using the nearby windshaft or continue on your raid. You'll also find a few items in the shelter (not too worthy).

entry.title: How does crossplay and cross-save work in Marathon
entry.summary:
We are all set to get the first taste of Marathon with the coming Server Slam event, and it will have crossplay and cross-save support from the get-go.
These two features will be fundamental parts of the full game when it launches later on March 5. Let's look at how the two systems work, and how you can make the most of them on your adventures.
Table of contents How does crossplay work in Marathon How does cross-save work in Marathon
How does crossplay work in Marathon
Crossplay in Marathon ensures that you can play with your buddies regardless of the platforms they're on. There will be full crossplay support between PC and console, allowing you to bridge the gap.
Crossplay will likely be turned on by default if we look at Bungie's other hit title, Destiny 2. There should be a feature to opt out of crossplay in Marathon. For that, we will need to have the full version in our hands.
Naturally, crossplay should result in quicker matchmaking since you'll be in a larger player pool. Do note that you can also opt to play with a controller on PC if you want.
How does cross-save work in Marathon
Cross-save in Marathon will enable you to transfer your progress between multiple platforms. This feature will be required if you plan to play Marathon on a PC and console interchangeably. If you connect your Bungie account with the platforms, you can enjoy shared progress. Otherwise, you'll have to grind on two separate platforms (which always feels like a chore to me).
Moreover, cross-save will also allow you to carry over your in-game purchases across platforms. This is immensely useful since buying the same cosmetic twice makes no sense at all. This also applies to all cosmetics that you unlock through in-game grind. Overall, I have really enjoyed this feature on ARC Raiders, and looking forward to it on Marathon as well.

entry.title: "Climate change isn’t about AI itself, it's about progress" - 11 Bit talk Frostpunk: 1886 and questions of scale
entry.summary:
It’s always a pleasure to write about Frostpunk, but I’m glum that Frostpunk has boarded the Great Videogame Remaking Train. I don’t think the original Frostpunk is beyond improvement, but I do find it very complete. Chilly finitude, obsessive symmetry are its narrative ethos and aesthetic. It’s a three-act story in a genre that tends to be exhaustingly open-ended. Its dramatic stakes are stark and inescapable – who and what will you sacrifice so that everybody else can survive? In place of the hopelessly indulgent, always-extendable gridiron of SimCity it gives you an Omelasian foxhole, with construction rigorously defined by distance from the coal burner at the heart. The Last City's inner configuration may vary, but it must describe a perfect circle, because it has to dissipate heat evenly against the apocalyptic winter. It can’t afford to sprawl.
But sprawl Frostpunk has - firstly in the form of DLC expansions, and then in the shape of Frostpunk 2: a looser, fragmented game of expansionism, bickering council members, tangled ideologies, and petrol politics. And now here’s Frostpunk: 1886, an Unreal Engine “remake plus plus”, as game director Maciej Sułecki puts it, in a sector saturated with boutique revivals, some of them landing a handful of years after the original game - a forcing of embryonic nostalgia, huffing on embers, that suggests an industry running out of fuel, giving itself over to cycles of regeneration.
Still, perhaps I’m being too gloomy. I’m definitely being melodramatic. As you’d expect, Sułecki has a more hopeful analysis.

entry.title: "Creativity is the key": how PC hardware's smaller manufacturers are navigating the RAM shortage disaster
entry.summary: Far from ushering in a technological golden age, artificial intelligence is giving PC hardware its most trying time in years. As huge, hyper-rich tech companies go about building resource-intensive AI data centres in pursuit of future wealth, the resulting memory chip shortages have detonated consumer-level pricing for RAM modules, graphics cards, SSDs, and even ancient hard drives. Doubling or tripling street-level outlays without harming sales would, you’d think, make a lot of gaming gear makers – especially their accounting departments – very happy indeed. But as those chips have become a scarce commodity at the supplier level, even the bigger hardware businesses are being squeezed as well, and it shows. Razer can’t decide how much their next laptops should cost. Valve are running out of Steam Deck stock and delaying the new Steam Machine. Zotac Korea called the RAM shortage an existential threat. But what of the industry’s smaller players – those producers of the niche, the quirky, the retro? Read more

It’s natural to spend a lot of time thinking about what games could have been, had different decisions been made. Whether the change is preferable to the reality often doesn’t come into it, the fantasy of another possible world is the draw. entry.title: U.S. Rightsholders Applaud India’s “Lock and Suspend” Piracy Blockades
entry.summary: After a decade of cat-and-mouse games, India’s site-blocking machine has evolved from basic ISP blocks into a global domain-deletion engine that also targets American domain registrars. This expansion is largely due to legal efforts by American companies, who applaud the "lock and suspend" orders while hoping to further increase their scope and effectiveness. entry.title: ScummVM 2026.1.0 "Like a Version" is finally released
entry.summary: Another year has gone by, therefore we are releasing a new ScummVM version. As you may notice right away, we are changing our version numbering schema, but that’s not all! We are also planning on more frequent releases!, which you can read about on sev’s blog. This could be the biggest release we have made so far in terms of the added features and engines. If I count correctly, we have added 12 new engines to our compatibility page. Not games, engines. In terms of games, it is challenging to count, since two of the engines, SLUDGE and WAGE are authoring tools, but if you count games in our detection tables, that adds up to at least 194 titles. entry.title: Audio recenze: SOS [Send Help] - 70 %
entry.summary: Je radost sledovat, že Sam Raimi mohl zase jednou natočit přesně to, co chtěl. Scénář je překvapivě chytrý, postavy (obě dvě) se zajímavě vyvíjejí a dlouho jsem se v kině tolik nesmál (na místech, kde si to režisér přál). Jediný podstatnější problém pro mě představovalo posledních asi 10 minut, kdy se hrálo až příliš na jistotu, všechno bylo hodně předvídatelné a zdaleka ne tak chytré jako předchozích 100 minut.
